scope: Explicit Holo package manifest, shared receipt resolution and production-loader creation of the native executor
repair: Adds an explicit Holo 3.1 4B candidate manifest with the already-tested immutable GGUF revision, exact model/projector bytes and SHA-256 values, and a 12 GiB installation floor. The current default remains Fara.

Fara and Holo share receipt/version/variant, exact two-artifact shape, strict data-directory, regular-file/non-symlink, size and containment checks. Runtime code must resolve within the signed application bundle. Installer checksum verification remains a separate prerequisite.

The existing visual executor loader recognizes a Holo package, activates and joins a validation worker, then returns the shared native desktop executor using managed Holo proposals and shutdown. Native task journals have a separate configurable directory.

Bundles a pinned Holo attribution notice alongside the existing Apache 2.0 and llama.cpp license texts. The upstream pinned model card declares Apache 2.0; it has no LICENSE file at that revision. The notice identifies the GGUF conversion and both exact artifacts.

A read-only diagnosticHistory accessor exposes the executor's already-retained, at-most-20 action records without extra capture, inference, input or storage. The loader test exports original retained proposals, rejection feedback and screenshot hashes after return. Terminal completion is not an action-history record; the final result retains its answer.
